import { closeSync, existsSync, openSync, readSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { Database } from 'bun:sqlite';
import { surfaceEventsDbPath } from '../domains/surface-events.js';

export type DirectiveAgent = 'claude-code' | 'codex' | 'elanous' | 'grok';
export interface DirectiveTurn {
  agent: DirectiveAgent;
  ts: string;
  sessionId: string;
  cwd?: string;
  text: string;
  sourceFile: string;
  lineNo: number;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
}
export interface SourceOptions {
  claudeRoot?: string;
  codexRoot?: string;
  grokRoot?: string;
  surfaceDb?: string;
  projectNames?: string[];
  offsets?: Record<string, number>;
  contexts?: Record<string, FileContext>;
}
export interface FileContext {
  lineNo: number; sessionId: string; cwd?: string; automatedCodex: boolean;
  sessionCwds: Record<string, string>; sessionAllowed: Record<string, boolean>;
  assistantCounts: Record<string, Record<string, number>>;
  firstCwd?: string; accepted?: boolean;
}
export interface SourceFile { path: string; agent: DirectiveAgent; end: number; turns: DirectiveTurn[]; context?: FileContext; truncated?: boolean }
export interface SourceScan { files: SourceFile[]; missingSources: DirectiveAgent[]; perSource: Record<DirectiveAgent, { files: number; directives: number }> }

function object(v: unknown): Record<string, any> { return v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? v as Record<string, any> : {}; }
function textOf(v: unknown): string {
  if (typeof v === 'string') return v;
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter(x => object(x).type === 'text' || object(x).type === 'input_text' || object(x).type === 'output_text').map(x => object(x).text).filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string').join('\n');
  return '';
}
export function cleanDirectiveText(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/<system-reminder\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/system-reminder>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<pasted_content\b[^>]*>/gi, '').replace(/<\/pasted_content>/gi, '').trim();
}
function human(text: string): boolean {
  return !!text && !/^(<task-notification\b|<system-reminder\b|This session is being continued from a previous conversation|<environment_context\b|You are the FINAL MERGE JUDGE\b|You are an AI assistant accessed via an API\b)/i.test(text);
}
/** A path segment must equal the project name — `/tmp/not-monad-agent-project` is not the project. */
export function allowed(cwd: string | undefined, names: string[]): boolean {
  if (!cwd) return false;
  const segments = cwd.toLowerCase().split(/[\\/]+/).filter(Boolean);
  return names.some(n => segments.includes(n.toLowerCase()));
}
function filesUnder(root: string, accept: (path: string) => boolean): string[] {
  if (!existsSync(root)) return [];
  const result: string[] = [];
  const visit = (dir: string) => {
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const path = join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) visit(path);
      else if (entry.isFile() && accept(path)) result.push(path);
    }
  };
  visit(root);
  return result.sort();
}
function parseLines(path: string, agent: 'claude-code' | 'codex' | 'grok', offset: number, names: string[], previous?: FileContext): SourceFile {
  let lineNo = previous?.lineNo ?? 0;
  let sessionId = previous?.sessionId ?? '';
  let cwd: string | undefined = previous?.cwd;
  let automatedCodex = previous?.automatedCodex ?? false;
  const sessionCwds = new Map(Object.entries(previous?.sessionCwds ?? {}));
  const sessionAllowed = new Map(Object.entries(previous?.sessionAllowed ?? {}));
  let firstCwd: string | undefined = previous?.firstCwd;
  let accepted: boolean | undefined = previous?.accepted;
  const assistantCounts: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = previous?.assistantCounts ?? {};
  const turns: DirectiveTurn[] = [];
  const parse = (chunk: string) => {
    lineNo++;
    if (!chunk) return;
    let row: Record<string, any>;
    try { row = object(JSON.parse(chunk)); } catch { return; }
    const payload = object(row.payload);
    if (agent === 'codex') {
      if (row.type === 'session_meta') {
        sessionId = payload.id ?? sessionId; cwd = payload.cwd ?? cwd;
        automatedCodex = typeof payload.originator === 'string' && payload.originator !== 'codex-tui' && payload.originator !== 'codex-cli'
          && payload.source !== 'vscode' && payload.source !== 'cli' && payload.source !== 'interactive';
      }
      if (row.type === 'turn_context') cwd = payload.cwd ?? cwd;
    } else {
      sessionId = row.sessionId ?? row.session_id ?? sessionId;
      cwd = agent === 'grok' ? decodeURIComponent(basename(dirname(path))) : row.cwd ?? cwd;
    }
    const role: 'user' | 'assistant' | null = agent === 'codex'
      ? row.type === 'event_msg' && payload.type === 'user_message' ? 'user'
        : row.type === 'response_item' && payload.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : null
      : agent === 'grok'
        ? typeof row.prompt === 'string' ? 'user' : null
        : row.type === 'user' && !row.isMeta && !row.isSidechain && !object(row.message).isMeta ? 'user'
        : row.type === 'assistant' && !row.isSidechain ? 'assistant' : null;
    if (!role || (agent === 'codex' && automatedCodex)) return;
    const raw = agent === 'codex' ? role === 'user' ? payload.message : textOf(payload.content)
      : agent === 'grok' ? row.prompt : textOf(object(row.message).content ?? row.content);
    const text = cleanDirectiveText(typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : '');
    if (!text || (role === 'user' && !human(text))) return;
    if (agent === 'claude-code') {
      if (role === 'user' && !sessionAllowed.has(sessionId)) {
        sessionCwds.set(sessionId, cwd ?? '');
        sessionAllowed.set(sessionId, allowed(cwd, names));
      }
      firstCwd = sessionCwds.get(sessionId);
      accepted = sessionAllowed.get(sessionId);
    } else if (role === 'user' && accepted === undefined) {
      firstCwd = cwd;
      accepted = agent === 'grok' || allowed(firstCwd, names);
    }
    if (!accepted) return;
    if (role === 'assistant') {
      const match = /^\*\*\[([STFO])\]\*\*/.exec(text);
      if (match) {
        const tally = assistantCounts[sessionId] ?? {};
        tally[match[1]!] = (tally[match[1]!] ?? 0) + 1;
        assistantCounts[sessionId] = tally;
      }
    }
    turns.push({ agent, ts: row.timestamp ?? row.ts ?? '', sessionId: sessionId || path, cwd: firstCwd ?? cwd, text, sourceFile: path, lineNo, role });
  };
  const fd = openSync(path, 'r');
  let end = offset;
  let pending = Buffer.alloc(0);
  const block = Buffer.allocUnsafe(64 * 1024);
  try {
    let cursor = offset;
    while (true) {
      const count = readSync(fd, block, 0, block.length, cursor);
      if (!count) break;
      cursor += count;
      const data = pending.length ? Buffer.concat([pending, block.subarray(0, count)]) : block.subarray(0, count);
      let start = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        if (data[i] !== 10) continue;
        parse(data.subarray(start, i).toString('utf8'));
        end += i - start + 1;
        start = i + 1;
      }
      pending = Buffer.from(data.subarray(start));
    }
  } finally { closeSync(fd); }
  return { path, agent, end, turns, context: {
    lineNo, sessionId, cwd, automatedCodex, sessionCwds: Object.fromEntries(sessionCwds),
    sessionAllowed: Object.fromEntries(sessionAllowed), assistantCounts, firstCwd, accepted,
  } };
}

/** Reads existing sources only; never initializes or migrates the surface-events database. */
export function scanDirectiveSources(opts: SourceOptions = {}): SourceScan {
  const roots = {
    'claude-code': opts.claudeRoot ?? join(homedir(), '.claude', 'projects'),
    codex: opts.codexRoot ?? join(homedir(), '.codex', 'sessions'),
    grok: opts.grokRoot ?? join(homedir(), '.grok'),
  };
  const dbPath = opts.surfaceDb ?? surfaceEventsDbPath();
  const perSource: SourceScan['perSource'] = {
    'claude-code': { files: 0, directives: 0 }, codex: { files: 0, directives: 0 },
    elanous: { files: 0, directives: 0 }, grok: { files: 0, directives: 0 },
  };
  const files: SourceFile[] = [];
  const missingSources: DirectiveAgent[] = [];
  for (const agent of ['claude-code', 'codex', 'grok'] as const) {
    if (!existsSync(roots[agent])) { missingSources.push(agent); continue; }
    const acceptedFile = (path: string) => agent === 'grok'
      ? basename(path) === 'prompt_history.jsonl' && path.includes(`${join(roots.grok, 'sessions')}/`)
      : agent === 'codex' ? basename(path).startsWith('rollout-') && path.endsWith('.jsonl')
      : path.endsWith('.jsonl') && !path.includes('/subagents/');
    const candidates = filesUnder(roots[agent], acceptedFile);
    if (agent === 'grok' && candidates.length === 0) { missingSources.push('grok'); continue; }
    for (const path of candidates) {
      const previous = opts.offsets?.[path] ?? 0;
      const truncated = previous > statSync(path).size || (previous > 0 && !opts.contexts?.[path]);
      const offset = truncated ? 0 : previous;
      const file = parseLines(path, agent, offset, opts.projectNames ?? ['monad-agent', 'elanous'], offset ? opts.contexts?.[path] : undefined);
      file.truncated = truncated;
      files.push(file);
      perSource[agent].files++;
      perSource[agent].directives += file.turns.filter(t => t.role === 'user').length;
    }
  }
  if (!existsSync(dbPath)) missingSources.push('elanous');
  else {
    const db = new Database(dbPath, { readonly: true });
    try {
      const offset = opts.offsets?.[dbPath] ?? 0;
      const rows = db.prepare("SELECT rowid, id, ts, session_id, text, refs, kind FROM events WHERE rowid > ? AND direction = 'inbound' AND kind IN ('utterance', 'qna') ORDER BY rowid").all(offset) as Array<{ rowid: number; id: string; ts: string; session_id: string | null; text: string; refs: string | null; kind: string }>;
      const turns: DirectiveTurn[] = [];
      for (const row of rows) {
        let refs: Record<string, any> = {};
        try { refs = object(JSON.parse(row.refs ?? '{}')); } catch { /* invalid provenance is not user text */ }
        if (refs.origin && refs.origin !== 'elanous-self') continue;
        const userPart = row.kind === 'qna' && row.text.startsWith('Q: ') ? row.text.slice(3).split('\nA:')[0]! : row.text;
        const text = cleanDirectiveText(userPart);
        if (human(text)) turns.push({ agent: 'elanous', ts: row.ts, sessionId: row.session_id ?? row.id, cwd: refs.cwd, text, sourceFile: dbPath, lineNo: row.rowid, role: 'user' });
      }
      files.push({ path: dbPath, agent: 'elanous', end: rows.at(-1)?.rowid ?? offset, turns });
      perSource.elanous.files = 1;
      perSource.elanous.directives = turns.length;
    } finally { db.close(); }
  }
  return { files, missingSources, perSource };
}
